cc:Work.dc:title: Compare the same records before comparing the models.
cc:Work.dc:description: Candidate minus logistic regression · negative favors candidate · 114 fixed held-out predictions Source: pinned UCI WDBC predictions. Bars: pointwise 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 paired, class-stratified resamples. 4/4 intervals include zero. This is not proof of equivalence, multiplicity-adjusted inference, or uncertainty from retraining.
